set.body:
Scheduling lane: maintenance. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Retained with its original acceptance scope; recheck against current code before implementation or closure. Not a prerequisite for the annotation-assisted preview.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 2 Scoring channel (LLM score-contract pilot).

A direct-label win does not show that a language model can supply candidate scores to the decoder. This pilot is a development arm; its outcome is recorded either way.

Scope:
Declare and test the score contract.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The extraction method is declared (e.g. candidate-label likelihoods or an explicit reranker), with candidate set and order, score direction and normalization, context and retry budgets, and unavailable-score outcomes; prompt and receipt are pinned.
2. A generated label, a verbal confidence or an absent candidate never silently becomes a probability vector, a certainty or a zero score (tests).
3. Candidate coverage and rerun agreement are written to a committed receipts file.
4. A dated study-log ledger entry (docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md) naming this read, its estimand and its participants is committed before the first gold read; the readout verifies the commit order.
5. Outcome recorded: the provider is admitted to the score channel, or H1 is reported unavailable for it.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: [maintenance] Phase 2: LLM score-contract pilot (a separately counted development arm)
